title: Why No One Has Measured The Speed Of Light
summary: Veritasium explains why the one-way speed of light has never been measured, only the round-trip speed, since measuring it requires synchronized clocks that assume the answer. It explores the implications for relativity.
why: Used as the standard reference in threads about light speed, clock synchronization and untestable assumptions in physics.

quote.text: I found the video very compelling even as a thought experiment.
